PhotoCraft's Korean, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Ukrainian, Dutch, Czech, Turkish,
Hungarian and Serbian UI translation catalogs are licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0, at your option.
The full license texts are in ../../../../LICENSE-MIT and ../../../../LICENSE-APACHE.

Korean translations: PhotoCraft contributors, original translations of
PhotoCraft's English labels; no proprietary translation resources were used.
